name.ja: 整合質量FEM弦の一般化固有値

caption.ja: 内部63点で計算した、M正規化された最低3モード。
caption.en: The first three M-normalized modes computed on the 63-node interior grid.

note.ja: 要素からK,Mを組み立て、M内積のK^-1M KrylovとSciPy LOBPCGを比較。小規模な厳密K逆前処理。 LOBPCG初期列は{1,x³,x⁶}。K逆Mの次数+2像を初期spanから独立にし、{1,x,x²}の構造的階数欠落を避ける。 同じMの作用を資格済einsumのLinearOperatorで与え、dense-B adapterを通さない。固有値solver自体はSciPy LOBPCG。
note.en: Elementwise K and M assembly, M-inner-product Krylov iteration on K^-1 M, and actual SciPy LOBPCG with a small exact-K-inverse preconditioner. LOBPCG starts from {1, x^3, x^6}; degree-plus-two images avoid the structural rank defect of {1, x, x^2}. The same M is applied through a qualified einsum LinearOperator, avoiding the dense-B adapter. The eigensolver itself remains SciPy LOBPCG.

note.en: Analytic reference Unit length, tension and density, homogeneous Dirichlet endpoints, 15/31/63 interior nodes, and the lowest three eigenpairs.
